Write code that returns word or segment timestamps from a transcription result using a concrete provider.

You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text

  SDK: assemblyai

  Documented operations: transcripts.submit, transcripts.get
  Setup hints: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY

  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_transcription_job, get_transcription_job
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 4 — Azure AI Speech:
  Service: Azure AI Speech
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechRecognizer, recognize_once_async
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/speech-to-text

Option 5 — Cloud Speech-to-Text:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: long_running_recognize, recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs

  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Recognition.call, Paraformer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/speech-recognition

output_text:
```python
import os
from ibm_watson import SpeechToTextV1
from ibm_cloud_sdk_core.authenticators import IAMAuthenticator

def batch_speech_to_text(audio_files):
    """
    Transcribe multiple audio files using IBM Watson Speech to Text and return
    a list of dictionaries containing the transcript and word timestamps.
    """
    # Use credentials from environment variables
    apikey = os.getenv('IBM_STT_APIKEY')
    url = os.getenv('IBM_STT_URL')

    # Authenticate with Watson
    authenticator = IAMAuthenticator(apikey)
    service = SpeechToTextV1(authenticator=authenticator)
    service.set_service_url(url)

    results = []

    for audio_file in audio_files:
        # Transcribe the audio file
        with open(audio_file, 'rb') as audio_data:
            response = service.recognize(
                audio=audio_data,
                content_type='audio/wav',
                timestamps=True
            ).get_result()

        # Extract transcription and word timestamps
        transcript = response['results'][0]['alternatives'][0]['transcript']
        words = response['results'][0]['alternatives'][0]['word_confidence']
        timestamps = [(word['word'], word['start'], word['end']) for word in words]

        results.append({
            'audio_file': audio_file,
            'transcript': transcript,
            'timestamps': timestamps
        })

    return results
```
